The Curvature by Which the Mode Actually Moves

Source: R/outer_gradient.R
mode_curvature.Rd

Computes the difference between the true Hessian of the penalized log-likelihood and the Gauss-Newton matrix that statmod_information_at() returns, where a term's block moves with its coefficients.

Usage

mode_curvature(spec, design, coef, params, npar, offs, total)

Arguments

spec

A StatmodSpec().

design

The design, already refreshed at coef.

coef

The coefficients at the penalized mode.

params, npar, offs, total

The block bookkeeping.

Value

A symmetric matrix over the stacked coefficients, with nonzero entries only on the blocks of refreshable terms.

Details

\(v = \partial\hat\beta/\partial\theta\) solves \((\partial^2\rho/\partial\beta^2 - \partial^2\ell/\partial\beta^2)v = -\partial^2\rho/\partial\beta\partial\theta\), and \(\partial^2\ell/\partial\beta^2\) is the true second derivative: $$\sum_i\sum_{a,b}\ell_{ab}\frac{\partial\eta_a}{\partial\beta} \frac{\partial\eta_b}{\partial\beta} + \sum_i\sum_a \ell_a\frac{\partial^2\eta_a}{\partial\beta^2}.$$ The design gives the first sum; the second is zero for every fixed block and is not for a refreshable one, where \(X\) is the Jacobian and so \(\partial^2\eta_i/\partial\beta_c\partial\beta_d = \partial X_{id}/\partial\beta_c\). It is supported on the term's own block, which keeps the computation cheap: one call of modelterms7::term_block_contract() per column, weighted by the score where u_refresh() weights by \(M\).

This is the matrix by which the mode moves, and it differs from the criterion's matrix. The determinant is of the matrix that statmod_information_at() assembles, and the derivative of the determinant is read from that matrix; how the mode moves depends on the penalized likelihood and is read from this one. The two coincide for the observed information when no block moves with its coefficients. With the expected information a single matrix for both would give a systematic error in the gradient, and the two are kept apart.

See also

u_refresh(), modelterms7::term_block_contract()
